body.x: RGBLABS (CEO, Kim Yong Deok) participated in ‘CES 2017’ held in Las Vegas in the U.S from January 5th to January 8th through a support from Smart Drone Technology Center of Kyungpook National University and introduced a controllable drone by network.

The product to be exhibited in the ‘CES 2017’ by RGBLABS, which provides drone-related hardware and software and specialized platforms, is operated by a connection of a drone, joystick, and PC not a general remote control.
It is possible to start and control a drone with a joystick and check the live flight information after the PC and drone are connected, so users can effectively and precisely take out a task.

Also, RGBLABS introduced its main goods, ‘BLUEBEE.’ BLUEBEE is an all-in-one drone main board, including ESC (Electronic Speed Controller), a flight control device, sensor, power supply device, and cable as main components of the drone at the center of the board. It is also a wide use drone board with a simple structure that is interchangeable with any drone components (motor, battery, propeller, and controller transmit receive module) and is designed to make R/C standard protocol such as PPM, CPPM, and more and UART communication protocol to overcome compatibility problems operate.

The CEO of RGBLABS, Kim Yong Deok, said, “This is the most basic platform and possible to be customized depending on the desired service. I hope to cooperate with individuals, enterprises, and government agencies that want to do a new drone service.”

Then, the Daegu Technopark and Smart Venture Institute and Smart Drone Technology Center of Kyungpook National University opened ‘CES Daegu Common Facility’ and supported the exhibition operation of 22 domestic enterprises and business meeting with a buyer.
